speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Trisomy 21 (Down Syndrome) complicated by malrotation of the midgut.

The physical findings of epicanthus, upward slanting eyelids, low-set ears, and a single transverse palmar crease are classic for Down Syndrome. The combination of bilious vomiting and a holosystolic murmur in this context strongly suggests malrotation with midgut volvulus, which is a critical surgical emergency. Immediate surgical consultation and an upper GI series are required.
